1.1.2.summary: Patchbay focus and packaging release: the focused node title stays readable, cables react to focus immediately, and the AUR `clara-bin` package builds, installs and updates correctly
changes: Patchbay: the focused node title is readable again (it was drawn with the canvas background colour on the header background, 1.30:1 contrast) and the theme now enforces a minimum contrast ratio for selection colours
Patchbay: cables refresh their gradients and routing the moment a node gains or loses focus, instead of only after the node is moved

AUR: `clara-bin` builds and installs again - the release asset's own pacman metadata is stripped, the download URL no longer breaks when the AUR `pkgrel` is bumped, and the noisy strip/debug pass is disabled
AUR: a manual sync workflow publishes packaging fixes without waiting for a full release, and the published `pkgrel` is now derived from the live AUR package instead of being reset on every release

1.1.1.summary: Stability and reliability patch: stops Cardinal crash-on-load, fixes the Add Plugin dialog selecting the wrong plugin, persists the plugin cache across restarts, collapses startup recovery into a single prompt, and makes the program filetype-agnostic with extensions owned solely by the save manager
changes: Cardinal (and other GLX/KV-Element/JUCE-UI) plugins no longer crash the host on load: they are auto-loaded in bridge mode when a project contains them
Add Plugin dialog: the Rack and Cards views now stay in sync with the (custom-sorted) table, so adding a plugin no longer inserts an unrelated one
Plugin list cache now includes LV2 and internal plugins and is pruned of stale entries, so a restart no longer needs a full rescan
Startup shows a single last-save/autosave recovery prompt instead of two back-to-back dialogs; recovered sessions load the autosave content under the last-saved name and path

Project filetype handling is now filetype-agnostic: the program works with filenames plus an opaque format tag, and only the save manager knows extensions (legacy .json projects remain loadable but stay out of file dialogs)

1.1.0.summary: Rich CLI startup banner and Ctrl+C prompt, plus tag/version consistency enforcement across the release pipeline
changes: CLI startup now renders a rich panel showing `Clara vX.Y.Z` followed by `based on Carla version A.B.C` (with Python/Qt/PyQt and path details); `--version` uses the same banner, with a plain-text fallback when `rich` is unavailable
The terminal Ctrl+C (SIGINT) prompt is now a rich panel: pressing Enter quits (default) and T keeps Clara running in the system tray

Release pipeline now enforces tag/version consistency: `scripts/check_version.sh` and a CI `version-check` job block a tag whose version does not match `base_version`/`releases.json`, and the release checkout uses `fetch-depth: 0` so the AUR `pkgver` bump fast-forwards cleanly
`scripts/release_and_push_aur.sh` now also bumps the internal `base_version`, preventing builds from self-reporting a stale version to the in-app updater

1.0.4.summary: Restored inline displays for in-process plugins, per-plugin bridge mode selection at add time, and a plugin-list/settings overhaul
changes: Restored inline display rendering (VU meters, scopes, plots) inside patchbay node boxes for in-process plugins, with canvas boxes sized to fit header/subbar so displays align below toolbar controls

Per-plugin bridge mode: new Mode selector in the add-plugin dialog (Default / In-process / Bridged) backed by PLUGIN_OPTION_USE_BRIDGE and PLUGIN_OPTION_AVOID_BRIDGE, overriding the global bridge preference and persisted with the plugin in the project
In-process mode enables inline displays, while bridged mode sandboxes the plugin (no inline display) for crash isolation
Settings UI: added Plugin Sandboxing & Bridges controls (master 'Enable plugin bridges' toggle plus 'Run plugins in bridge mode when possible') to the schema-driven Experimental tab
Plugin list: on-demand viewport rendering replacing bulk card/row allocation, fixing search/filter desync and the initial scroll jump, greatly reducing cold-start cost
Rack, canvas and statusbar refinements: flexible statusbar/toolbar layout for half-screen tiling, rack width/defocus stability, and reduced log-flood UI stalls

1.0.2.summary: OpenGL-first canvas rendering with uninterrupted signal flow, live pulse animations, log flood rate limiting, and Modern UI refinements
changes: OpenGL-first canvas: default to hardware acceleration for fluid drop shadows, cable glow, and 25 FPS signal-flow pulses without artificial throttle profiles
Signal flow & audio pulse fix: resolved ctypes pointer unwrap in libpulse read callback so PipeWire/PulseAudio peak meters reliably feed node pulsing and travelling line pulses
Log flood rate limiting: terminal log output capped at 60 lines/sec and UI log flushes batched (100ms) to stop high-frequency debug floods from freezing the UI thread
Modern UI default layout: side panel and canvas meters hidden by default in modern mode; floating toolbars and minimap anchored to the patchbay container
Settings dialog modernization: declarative 2-column layout with SettingsFormBuilder, sidebar icon separation to preserve native typography, and PipeWire external client mode preservation

1.0.0.summary: Clara 1.0.0 - patchbay overhaul: modal navigation, pluggable routing/arrange, animated signal flow, Catppuccin theming, and AppImage/Flatpak packaging
changes: Animated signal/event flow: travelling pulses along cables with comet tails and per-node glow driven by real engine levels (plugin peaks + external/PipeWire peak-detect via libpulse)
Patchbay search relocated into the top context toolbar, with persistent Ctrl+F selection and a restyled (Catppuccin blue) results dropdown
Pluggable routing engine: self-contained A* + flocking router and a new orthogonal (Manhattan) router, both obstacle-aware
Pluggable arrange algorithms: heuristic (pattern-aware) and Sugiyama layouts alongside classic/flow, selectable and persisted (Canvas/ArrangeStyle)
Graph introspection model (patchcanvas/graph_info.py) as the foundation for scripting/claractl
Major canvas performance pass: multi-second freeze on settings apply with pure-Python routers cut to a few hundred ms
Catppuccin theming across patchbay, settings and search; sidebar tabs and buttons use Nerd Font glyphs, legacy bitmap icons/options removed
Modal (Photoshop/Blender-style) canvas navigation, infinite canvas, marquee selection and minimap tracking
Session safety: rotating autosaves, countdown timers, dirty-edit tracking and save-on-exit prompts
New distribution targets: portable x86_64 AppImage and Flatpak builds (clara primary, carla kept as a backwards-compatible symlink)
